title: WR Potential Chart
description: Fantasy production compared with WOPR, followed by the 2025 year-one results. Published rebound calls improved 10 of 12 times. Methodology, baseline comparisons, and limitations.
label: Most Potential improved

title: RB Potential Chart
description: Fantasy production compared with carries, targets, and touchdowns. The 2025 results show stronger decline warnings than rebound calls. Includes year-one rates and baseline comparisons.
label: Least Potential declined

title: Momentum & Game Outcomes
description: AP Research study: can momentum-based statistics predict NBA game outcomes? Two-phase backtesting and forward-testing study using a novel Scoring Run Performance metric. 68.2% accuracy over 148 games.
label: 148 forward-tested games

title: Up-Down-Up Transfer Analysis
description: 503 players, 2020–26. Three-phase path analysis: competitive program → weaker school → return to competitive level. Only 45.3% meet the success threshold. System fit matters nearly as much as player quality.
label: Players tracked

title: D2-to-D1 Transfer Analysis
description: 566 players, 2020–26. The D2-to-D1 jump is harder than assumed; only 17.0% maintain relative production. WS/40 (r = 0.386) is the best single predictor. The profile of a player who translates is identifiable.
label: Players tracked

title: Translatability Index (TI)
description: Full methodology for the 0–100 composite score used across both transfer analyses. Five components: Efficiency, Jump Risk, System Fit, Trajectory, and Volume Appropriateness. Includes an explanation of the paradox in the success-rate-by-tier chart.
label: Translatability Index

title: Momentum & CBB Power Ratings
description: MA-NetRtg: a five-source momentum-adjusted power rating blending KenPom AdjEM, EvanMiya head-to-head data, schedule strength, kill shots, and roster quality. 10-fold CV R² = 0.984. Top 75 KenPom teams.
label: 10-fold CV R²

title: Archetypes & KenPom Ratings
description: Multiple regression analysis of all D1 teams: how strongly does archetype composition of a team’s best players predict KenPom rating? r = 0.72 for best player vs. team KenPom. 2025–26 season.
label: Best player vs. team KenPom

title: March Madness Trends (2002–2026)
description: 24 seasons of KenPom data. Seeding patterns, upset rates, conference dominance, ML feature importance (AUC = 0.756), coaching longevity, and the 2026 tournament field outlook.
label: Seasons analyzed
